title: The Jade Oasis
meta_description: The Jade Oasis delivers coastal comfort with a heated pool, hot tub, game room, and one-block beach access.
description_expanded:
Welcome to The Jade Oasis, a vibrant Panama City Beach escape where playful design, resort-style amenities, and effortless coastal living shape every moment. Set just one block from a beach access point, the home places you within easy reach of the sugar-white shoreline, St. Andrews State Park, Schooners, and the relaxed east-end marina and dining scene---an ideal setting for families and groups who want a mix of beach days, outdoor fun, and laid-back evenings.

Inside, the bright and colorful living area opens into an inviting open-concept layout centered around a plush sectional and large TV, perfect for movie nights and slow mornings. The full chef's kitchen offers modern appliances, generous counter space, and a dedicated coffee counter designed for ease and connection. A standalone ice maker in the laundry room keeps coolers ready for the beach or an afternoon by the pool.

The home offers five bedrooms and three bathrooms, sleeping up to fifteen guests. Two serene king rooms create restful retreats for couples or parents, while the spacious bunk room---featuring full-over-full bunks with a twin trundle---gives kids, teens, or friends plenty of room to spread out. A double-queen ensuite with patio access provides a private hideaway with its own bathroom and walk-out connection to the outdoors, and an additional queen bedroom rounds out the comfortable sleeping arrangements. The shared hallway bathroom includes a classic tub/shower combo, while the ensuite bath offers a walk-in shower.

Step outside and the home transforms into your own private resort. A heated dipping pool and separate hot tub invite relaxation from sunrise to late evening, with an outdoor shower, while the firepit offers a cozy spot to gather beneath the stars. The outdoor dining table, set against a bold mural backdrop, offers a memorable setting for group meals, celebrations, or post-beach snacks. The screened-in porch features two dedicated bar areas, perfect for mixing drinks, playing music, or unwinding out of the sun.

Just off the patio, the game room keeps the fun going with shuffleboard, darts, arcade games, foosball, and spike ball---an ideal hangout space that brings out everyone's competitive side. When you're ready to explore, optional bikes, surfboards, and a golf cart make it easy to cruise the neighborhood, reach local restaurants, or zip over to the beach within minutes. Driveway parking for three cars, a full laundry room, and thoughtful touches throughout ensure an easy, stress-free stay.

Colorful, comfortable, and crafted for connection, The Jade Oasis offers the perfect blend of coastal energy and modern amenities---an inviting home base for guests looking to make the most of their time in Panama City Beach.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

Panama City Beach is one of Florida's most welcoming coastal destinations, known for its 27 miles of sugar-white sand, emerald Gulf waters, and a vibrant mix of family-friendly attractions, waterfront dining, and outdoor adventure. Guests can spend their days exploring St. Andrews State Park, spotting dolphins on Shell Island excursions, savoring fresh seafood at local institutions like Schooners, or enjoying the lively entertainment and shopping at Pier Park. With its easygoing atmosphere, year-round sunshine, and endless blend of relaxation and recreation, PCB offers something for every type of traveler---from beach lovers and boaters to families, foodies, and groups looking to unwind by the water.

Local Attractions: Pier Park, Dolly Pirate Ship, Top Golf, Shipwreck Island Waterpark, Russell-Fields Pier, St. Andrews State Park, Thomas Drive, Shell Island, Conservation Park, WonderWorks, Ripley's Believe It or Not, Camp Helen State Park, Frank Brown Park, Panama City Beach Winery, Aaron Bessant Park, Laguna Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Guests can enjoy complimentary use of the bikes during their stay. Waivers must be signed prior to use.
- Please note that pool heat is available at $150 per night.
- Please note your home comes equipped with a pack'n'play and high-chair.
- Golf cart rental is available for $107 per day and must be booked for the entire length of the stay; partial-day rentals are not allowed. Waivers must be signed prior to use.
- Please note: Complimentary beach gear is provided (chairs, umbrellas, wagon, and coolers), subject to availability and condition.

Parking Details:
- Private driveway parking for 3 cars.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
